purpose: Freeze the spatial-risk v2 hypothesis, estimator, feature set, selection rule, scientific gates, and data-access boundary before any v2 fitting or new data capture.

scientific_scope.pipeline: RGB-D + language -> frozen B0 grounding -> relation-aware spatial-risk estimation -> calibrated uncertainty -> ACT/REOBSERVE/ABSTAIN
scientific_scope.hypothesis: With the grounding backbone held fixed, a shallow nonlinear risk estimator using only pre-existing, oracle-free B0 consistency and RGB-D geometry features, followed after estimator freeze by monotone affine-logit calibration on a new family-disjoint calibration split, will reduce unsafe target acceptance while preserving the locked grounding and output-contract gates.
scientific_scope.claim_boundary: This lock preregisters a testable revision; it is not evidence that the hypothesis is true and does not authorize a Test-IID, Test-OOD, or robot claim.

historical_evidence_and_nonindependence.observed_result: NEGATIVE: temperature scaling improved Brier from 0.139282 to 0.137580 but worsened ECE-10 from 0.049936 to 0.051019; the probability-calibration gate failed.
historical_evidence_and_nonindependence.consequence: The v2 design is post hoc with respect to Calibration-v2. Calibration-v2 is permanently historical/read-only for v2 and cannot be reused for fitting, feature selection, hyperparameter selection, threshold selection, calibration, early stopping, or success evaluation.
historical_evidence_and_nonindependence.no_retroactive_claim: No v2 result may be described as preregistered with respect to Calibration-v2.

grounding_backbone.role: The sole grounding backbone and comparator for v2.

unsafe_definition.found_unsafe: B0 returns FOUND and the semantic point is missing, invalid, out of bounds, or has normalized Euclidean target error greater than 0.08.
unsafe_definition.safe: B0 returns FOUND with exactly one finite in-bounds semantic point whose normalized Euclidean target error is at most 0.08.
unsafe_definition.risk_target: P(unsafe | RGB, depth_view, instruction, frozen B0 prediction)
unsafe_definition.label_prohibition: Ground-truth target coordinates, unsafe labels, evaluator output, and future split metadata may be used as training labels or evaluation data only in their authorized split role; none may enter inference features.

method_v2.preprocessing: No fitted scaler, imputer, or learned feature transform. Cast the locked feature vector to finite float64; a non-finite feature is an invalid pipeline output and may not be silently imputed.
method_v2.fit_rule: Fit exactly once on Train-UQ labels using the parameters above. Use no class reweighting, resampling, early stopping, or hyperparameter sweep.

difference_from_logistic_l2_v1.model_change: Replace StandardScaler + L2 LogisticRegression(C=0.1) with a fixed-capacity shallow histogram gradient-boosted tree model so that a small number of nonlinearities and feature interactions can be represented without an architecture search.
difference_from_logistic_l2_v1.feature_change: Remove action_ABSTAIN and exact_contract because they were constant/non-informative under frozen B0, and remove predicted_x and predicted_y to prevent absolute image-position shortcuts. Retain relation identity plus oracle-free consistency and local RGB-D geometry signals.
difference_from_logistic_l2_v1.calibrator_change_after_estimator_freeze: Replace one-parameter temperature scaling sigmoid(logit(p)/T) with positive-slope affine-logit scaling sigmoid(exp(log_a)*logit(p)+b), allowing slope and base-rate correction while preserving ranking.
difference_from_logistic_l2_v1.unchanged: B0, unsafe labels, feature extraction semantics for retained features, evaluation metrics, scientific eligibility gates, threshold grid, and test/robot sealing remain unchanged.

feature_contract.source_semantics: For every retained feature, reuse the exact extraction and normalization semantics locked for spatial-risk v1; only the four explicitly removed columns change.
forbidden_features: family, split, layout, or capture identifiers
Test-IID or Test-OOD data or metadata

train_split.name: Train-UQ
train_split.role: The only split allowed to fit the v2 estimator.

validation_split.name: Val-UQ
validation_split.role: The only split allowed for the v2 development eligibility decision and operating-threshold selection.
validation_split.independence_status: Development data already observed in earlier work; it is not confirmatory evidence.

new_development_data.rule: If new development data become necessary, this lock must first receive an append-only, timestamped amendment that freezes its namespace, family exclusions, sample count, and purpose before capture. Such data remain development-only and cannot serve as Calibration-v3 or Test.

development_data_and_selection.eligibility_evaluation: Evaluate the single frozen estimator on Val-UQ against frozen B0 using the unchanged gates below.

threshold_grid.decision: ABSTAIN iff raw risk >= threshold; otherwise preserve the B0 action and point.

development_data_and_selection.method_selection_rule: The lock authorizes exactly one estimator candidate. It is eligible only if all development gates pass on Val-UQ; its selection objective remains lowest Val-UQ AURC, with the pre-existing tie-break order of lower non-FOUND false-accept rate, higher FOUND Hit@0.08, then simpler method. With one candidate, no cross-method tie can occur.
development_data_and_selection.threshold_selection_rule: Among thresholds satisfying every operating-point gate, choose lexicographically: lowest non-FOUND false-accept rate, highest FOUND Hit@0.08, highest corrected safe-task rate, highest coverage, then lowest threshold. No threshold satisfies all gates => development failure.
development_data_and_selection.after_selection: Persist one estimator artifact, its exact code/environment hashes, feature order, raw Val-UQ predictions, selected threshold, metrics, bootstrap summary, and decision; then freeze them before any Calibration-v3 materialization or access.

metric_definitions.ece_10: Ten equal-width probability bins on [0,1], with the final bin including 1.0; omit empty bins; ECE is the sample-weighted absolute confidence-accuracy gap.
metric_definitions.brier: Mean squared error between predicted unsafe probability and binary unsafe label.
metric_definitions.aurc: Area under the risk-coverage curve; lower is better.
metric_definitions.found_hit_0_08: FOUND prediction has one finite in-bounds point with normalized Euclidean target error at most 0.08.

development_eligibility_gates: FOUND Hit@0.08 delta versus B0 must be at least -0.125.
Non-FOUND abstain recall must be strictly higher than B0.
Non-FOUND false-accept rate must be strictly lower than B0.
Exact output-contract rate must not be lower than B0.
AURC must be no worse than the locked comparator.
INVALID outputs may not be counted as ABSTAIN.

fresh_calibration_after_method_freeze.materialization_condition: May be captured/materialized only after the v2 estimator, raw-risk implementation, and Val-UQ threshold have passed the development gates and received a separate immutable freeze artifact.
fresh_calibration_after_method_freeze.family_disjointness: Every parent family, scene/layout seed, and capture identifier must be disjoint from Train-UQ, Val-UQ, Dev-v2, Calibration-v2, Test-IID, and Test-OOD. Disjointness must be machine-audited and locked before labels or model outputs are inspected.
fresh_calibration_after_method_freeze.minimum_design: Before capture, create a separate calibration-v3 contract fixing sample count and the cross of relation class with unsafe state; do not infer these choices after observing outcomes.

calibrator.ranking_requirement: Positive slope is mandatory; AUROC and AURC before versus after calibration must be identical within absolute tolerance 1e-12.

fresh_calibration_after_method_freeze.probability_success_gate: On Calibration-v3, ECE-10 must strictly decrease and Brier must strictly decrease relative to the same frozen v2 raw probabilities.
fresh_calibration_after_method_freeze.operating_point_gate: Using calibrated risk and the unchanged 0.00-to-1.00 step-0.01 threshold grid, at least one threshold must satisfy: exact-contract rate not lower than B0, FOUND Hit@0.08 delta at least -0.125, non-FOUND abstain recall strictly higher than B0, non-FOUND false-accept rate strictly lower than B0, and INVALID not counted as ABSTAIN. Together with the ranking-invariance requirement and the Val-UQ AURC eligibility gate, this preserves the existing scientific gates without redefining them.
fresh_calibration_after_method_freeze.important: A calibration pass permits creation/review of a separate Test access lock only; it does not itself open Test-IID/OOD or authorize robot ACT.

allowed_now: Fit the single locked v2 estimator on Train-UQ.
Evaluate eligibility and select one threshold on Val-UQ.
Read historical v1 and Calibration-v2 artifacts solely for provenance and comparison reporting.
forbidden_now: Any fitting, tuning, feature choice, threshold choice, calibration, early stopping, or retry based on Calibration-v2.
Capture, materialize, label, preview, or evaluate Calibration-v3 before the v2 estimator freeze and a separate pre-capture Calibration-v3 contract.
Create, preview, unseal, or run Test-IID or Test-OOD.
Use robot outcomes for development or execute robot ACT, REOBSERVE, or ABSTAIN evaluation.
Change B0 or the unsafe, ECE-10, Brier, AURC, output-contract, or scientific gate definitions.

deviation_policy: Any change to B0, features, estimator family, hyperparameters, fitting rule, selection rule, metric/gate definitions, calibrator, or data boundary invalidates this method identity. A timestamped replacement hypothesis lock must be created before using data under the revised method; no outcome-contingent amendment is allowed.
assertions: This file is a preregistration artifact, not a positive result.
Only one v2 estimator candidate is authorized by this lock.
Calibration-v2 can never be relabeled as v2 calibration evidence.
A pipeline run is not scientific-gate success.
Test-IID, Test-OOD, Gazebo robot integration, and real UR3 remain closed.
